name: What types of flooring materials can Frasheski Construction coordinate for installation?

mainEntity.name: What types of flooring materials can Frasheski Construction coordinate for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction coordinates the installation of a wide range of flooring materials, catering to diverse project needs and aesthetic preferences. This includes common options like hardwood, engineered wood, laminate, luxury vinyl plank (LVP), and tile. We also handle specialized materials such as natural stone, concrete, and carpet. Our coordination services ensure that the specific requirements for each material, such as subfloor preparation, moisture mitigation, or specific installation techniques, are met. For example, hardwood and engineered wood require precise acclimation periods within the project site to prevent warping or gapping after installation. This preparation is a critical part of our coordination process.
acceptedAnswer.description: We coordinate installation for various materials, including hardwood, engineered wood, laminate, LVP, tile, natural stone, concrete, and carpet.
